name: DeckForge MCP
tagline: Turn meeting notes, memos, and spreadsheet numbers into ready-to-present, editable slide decks.
description: DeckForge helps business leaders, chiefs of staff, finance teams, and consultants turn rough notes, memos, or spreadsheet tables into clear, well-structured presentations. Preview every slide across 4 architectural design styles and 8 slide layouts, customize chart types, edit headlines and talking points in plain English, and download a fully editable PowerPoint (.pptx) file or 1-page Meeting Read-Ahead Brief.

reviewer_credentials.notes: No password required for OAuth 2.1 PKCE dynamic registration, or pass api_key='df_pro_enterprise' for unlimited Pro tier verification.

pricing.free_tier: 3 presentations / month (all 8 templates, 8 layouts, and 4 architectural design styles included free)
pricing.pro_tier: $24/month for unlimited editable PowerPoint (.pptx) & online slide decks

privacy_and_security.data_retention: Your notes and numbers are processed in-memory to build your slides and are never stored or used to train AI models.
privacy_and_security.encryption: Encrypted in transit over HTTPS with OAuth 2.1 S256 PKCE sign-in protection.

verification_test_prompts: Turn our Q3 business update (Revenue $18.4M +142% YoY, Net Retention 124%, Gross Margin 81%) into a 6-slide Boardroom Navy presentation and give me a downloadable PowerPoint file.
Change Slide 2 to a Quarterly Bar Chart layout and tighten the headline and speaker talking points.
